scripts.build: npm run build -w @terror/contracts && npm run build -w @terror/server && npm run build -w @terror/game && npm run build -w @terror/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @terror/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @terror/contracts && npm run build -w @terror/server && npm run test -w @terror/contracts && npm run test -w @terror/server
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @terror/contracts && npm run build -w @terror/server && npm run test:integration -w @terror/server
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @terror/contracts && npm run build -w @terror/server && npm run dev -w @terror/server
scripts.dev:game: npm run build -w @terror/contracts && npm run dev -w @terror/game
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build -w @terror/contracts && npm run dev -w @terror/admin
